features: PERFORMANCE: Segment’s Fastest Smartphone, powered by Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset with an AnTuTu score of 1Mn+, paired with UFS 3.1 and 256GB storage. Gaming features include Dual 10x Super Touch Control, Monster Mode, in-game overlay notifications, 4D game vibration, and Game Voice Changer for an immersive gaming experience.

BATTERY: Segment’s Biggest Battery, Z11x packs a massive 7200mAh battery. Supports 1600 complete charging cycles maintaining battery health for up to 6 years. 44W FlashCharge, battery temperature control, and overnight charging protection ensure fast and safe charging. Supports Bypass charging, with 25-Dimension Security Protection and PPS support.

OPERATING SYSTEM: Running on OriginOS 6, the Z11x offers 2 years of Android updates and 4 years of security patches. Key features include AI Captions, AI Creation, AI Transcript Assist, Circle to Search, and Screen Translation. It also includes Private Space for added privacy, Origin Island with Drag & Go, Copy & Go, and lock screen customisation.
IP & DURABILITY: Industry’s Leading IP68 & IP69+ dust and water resistance. It also comes with Military Grade Durability, designed to withstand drops, shocks, and tough daily use.

CAMERA: The Z11x includes a 50MP Sony IMX 852 Ultra-HD AI-powered main camera with a 32MP front camera. It supports 4K video recording on both front and rear cameras, 4K Video-to-Live Photo conversion, Dual-View Video Recording, Video Electronic Image Stabilisation (EIS), and Live Photo.
description: The Z11x is powered by the MediaTek 7400-Turbo processor, with an AnTuTu score of 1Mn+, and features UFS 3.1 and 256GB storage. It comes with a 7200mAh battery rated for 1600 full charging cycles and designed to maintain battery health for up to 6 years, delivering 15.4 hours of gaming, 18.7 hours of social media use, and 40 hours of video playback, supported by 44W Smart FlashCharge and Bypass Charging. The device runs Origin OS 6 with 2 years of Android updates and 4 years of security patches, and includes AI Captions, AI Creation, AI Transcript Assist, and Origin Island with Drag & Go and Copy & Go. It also features IP68 and IP69+ dust and water resistance with Military Grade Durability, along with a 50MP Sony AI main camera and 32MP front camera supporting 4K video recording on both front and rear cameras, Dual-View Video, EIS, Live Photo, and 4K Video-to-Live Photo conversion.
